info.title: Academia Espronceda Application API
info.description: Versioned public contract used by Angular to communicate with NestJS.

200.description: Authenticated session created; session and XSRF cookies are set by NestJS

post.summary: Move one or more people from the waiting list to active students

200.description: Activated people with their original identifiers

delete.description: Deletion is rejected when a draft or confirmed schedule references the person. No schedule assignments are deleted by cascade.

get.summary: List the minimal teacher options used by schedule selectors

200.description: Teacher selector options; no teacher administration data is exposed

get.summary: Get the public weekly slots and labels needed by Angular

200.description: Schedule revisions in descending creation order

get.summary: Get the current confirmed ordinary schedule

post.summary: Create an empty global weekly schedule draft
Generate a global weekly schedule draft
post.description: NestJS obtains current domain data, invokes the private solver, validates the result independently, and returns a draft.

post.summary: Create an editable draft from a confirmed schedule

201.description: Draft revision created without modifying the confirmed source

post.summary: Assign an active student to a draft class
post.description: The command is rejected if it would exceed the student's contracted hours or violate any other hard rule.

delete.summary: Remove an assignment from a draft
delete.description: A draft may become temporarily under-assigned but can never be confirmed in that state.

post.description: The student's assigned-hour count remains unchanged throughout the command.

put.summary: Set explicit subject-to-teacher hours for a student served by multiple teachers
put.description: Each subject must be allocated in full to one teacher, and the total must match the student's assigned classes per teacher.

post.summary: Evaluate the complete schedule without invoking the solver

post.description: Confirmation requires the current revision and validation fingerprint. Relaxable capacity conflicts require explicit acceptance; hard findings always block confirmation.

200.description: Confirmed immutable schedule with persisted validation evidence

SessionCookie.name: __Host-academia_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict session cookie containing the JWT.

XsrfHeader.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
XsrfHeader.description: Double-submit XSRF token required for authenticated state-changing requests.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request or hard input invariant violation

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or the session is invalid

Forbidden.description: The XSRF token or request origin is invalid

NotFound.description: The requested entity does not exist

Conflict.description: The operation conflicts with current state, a hard rule, schedule references, or a stale revision

BadGateway.description: The private solver failed or its result disagreed with NestJS validation

message.description: Human-readable explanation rendered by NestJS in Spanish.
